proposals.name: Retro Handheld OS Customizers (Miyoo, Anbernic, Steam Deck)
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy retro gamers who spend hours customizing OnionOS, GarlicOS, or EmuELEC themes, seeking pixel-art icons, retro console-style custom SVG skins, and physical layout trackers.
product_angles: Digital retro-pixel icon packs and UI asset sheets optimized for 640x480 screens
Printable SVG skin templates designed for precise fit on Miyoo Mini Plus / RG35XX
KDP Retro Gaming Achievement & Backlog Tracker journal
proposals.first_test_product: OnionOS Pixel Art Theme Assets and SVG skin layouts

proposals.name: Wind Turbine Technicians
proposals.buyer_persona: Industrial climbers and technicians working on offshore/onshore wind farms. They take pride in extreme working heights and have highly specialized tools and safety codes.
product_angles: Redbubble sticker packs with industry humor (e.g., 'Climbing 100 meters for a reset')
KDP Wind Turbine Maintenance, Inspection & Safety Logbook
High-contrast vector t-shirt designs featuring technical schematic art of turbine nacelles
proposals.first_test_product: Wind Turbine Maintenance and Climb Logbook on KDP

proposals.name: French Heritage Villages (Les Plus Beaux Villages de France) B2B
proposals.buyer_persona: Local tourist offices and boutique owners in certified beautiful French villages looking for affordable, modern, localized souvenirs to sell to tourists.
product_angles: Custom coloring books dedicated to the specific architectural heritage of a single village (e.g., Saint-Cirq-Lapopie)
High-end vector line-art posters of local historical monuments for digital download/licensing
SVG map elements and vector postcards ready for local laser-engraving shops
proposals.first_test_product: Coloring Book 'Coloriage Patrimoine: Les Plus Beaux Villages du Lot'

proposals.name: Solo Board Game Players
proposals.buyer_persona: Enthusiastic hobbyists who play complex board games alone (r/soloboardgaming). They require session logs, custom card holders, and print-and-play components to manage heavy setups.
product_angles: KDP Solo Board Game Session Journal (tracking wins, losses, AI behavior, and strategies)
3D printable STL card stands, resource token trays, and deck holders optimized for low-footprint play (Cults3D)
Print-and-Play (PnP) custom campaign tracking sheets and scorepads (PDF format on Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: Solo Gamer Session Tracker & Campaign Journal on KDP

proposals.name: Extreme Cave Diving & Speleology
proposals.buyer_persona: Technical cave divers and speleologists with high disposable income. They are obsessed with safety protocols, gear configurations (sidemount), and specific line-marker iconography.
product_angles: KDP Cave Diving Logbook with technical gas-planning grids and safety checklists
Redbubble sticker designs featuring cave diving line arrows, cookies, and insider humor (e.g., 'Respect the Line')
Vector design packs of cave topography icons and mapping symbols for survey reports
proposals.first_test_product: Technical Cave Diving Logbook (Gas planning & Deco schedules)

proposals.name: Low-Poly Assets for Godot Engine Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building lightweight 3D games in Godot. They look for cohesive low-poly asset packs, modular dungeon sets, and UI layouts optimized for open-source workflows.
product_angles: Modular low-poly dungeon and interior tile kits (OBJ/GLTF format)
Godot-optimized UI theme assets (buttons, frames, progress bars as PNG/SVG slices)
Procedurally generated 3D rock/prop packs (Cults3D and itch.io)
